notes.title: "Dreaming in Cherry Blossoms, I Fall in Love with You" Release Date Announced✨
notes.notes:
The release date for the visual novel Dreaming in Cherry Blossoms, I Fall in Love with You has been set for July 31, 2025!
Don't forget to add it to your Steam Wishlist!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690420/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Steam Store Page Major Update ✨ Theme Song & PV Now Available!
notes.notes:
We’ve made a major update to the Steam store page for our game!

The key visual, screenshots, and game description have all been refreshed, and new sections introducing the characters and cast have been added.

We’ve also released the promotional video (PV) featuring the theme song “Melody of the Night Sky ～Miracle of the Cherry Blossoms～” sung by Rin Kurusu, who voices Cherry!

Get an early taste of the game’s world through this special video—be sure to check it out! 🌸
